cases.task: Design a service extracting typed invoice fields; no tools, interactive planning or external events are needed.
cases.expected: Choose a generator and explicit signature/validation; do not add agent/RLM/DAG by default; distinguish schema from execution and hard assertions from reward selection.

cases.task: Design support over a recurring repository, long individual investigations and tenant-specific recalled facts.
cases.expected: Separate cross-run corpus orientation via contextMap, within-run compaction via contextPolicy and per-turn retrieval via memories; application owns durable tenant storage and access control; compaction does not delete live runtime state.

cases.task: Design a webhook-driven multi-step review that pauses for an external result and later resumes after process restart.
cases.expected: Separate DAG composition from event inbox/routes/stores and explicit wake/resume; payloads are not automatically user messages; app chooses persistence and duplicate/idempotency policy, no automatic exactly-once guarantee.

cases.task: Design ticket triage requiring calibrated decision evidence, tool execution and a final explanation.
cases.expected: Separate supported typed Jev decisions from generative prose/tool actor; native probability/confidence is not guaranteed correctness; no implicit hybrid split.

cases.task: Design resilient interchangeable provider routing for a spoken-response application.
cases.expected: Require real audio-output capability independent of input; acceptable model substitutes under aliases; adaptive balance uses operational reliability/latency/cost not semantic quality routing; partial streamed output cannot be replayed transparently.

cases.task: Design a coding investigator with two specialists, runtime tools and focused semantic helper queries.
cases.expected: Use named child agents for tool-owning specialist responsibility, explicit input threading and namespaces; llmQuery is a narrow semantic helper not a tool-using child agent; use runtime only when code/state work warrants it.

cases.task: Design a multitenant agent that consumes MCP resources and can execute approved side-effecting tools.
cases.expected: Native MCP attachment preserves protocol, require verified app tenant identity and authorization before effects; remote content untrusted; caller-owned client closed; session identity is not tenant authentication.

cases.task: Design a purchasing assistant that must ask the user a structured question and continue after approval.
cases.expected: Public clarification throws AxAgentClarificationError and bypasses responder; save continuation state and restore before next forward; host approval and durable business state remain application-owned; do not retry purchase side effects blindly.

cases.task: Design how to improve task quality using examples, run-end feedback and occasional candidate selection.
cases.expected: Separate offline instruction/demo optimization, durable playbook knowledge evolution including online updates, and per-call reward/refine sampling; held-out validation and safe tools; bound model/evaluation cost.

cases.task: Design shared-agent usage accounting across tenants and processes with a production dashboard.
cases.expected: Process-global onUsage plus per-run attribution and durable external aggregation; instance getUsage is not centralized truth; observer failures fail-open and callbacks enqueue not await DB; tokens are not currency costs.

cases.task: Design image localization across TypeScript now and a possible generated-language port later.
cases.expected: Required native Jev box with experimental model/header/image constraints, presence boolean before consuming box; generative elicited provenance no fabricated native confidence; preserve conflicting generated-language availability claims and check package before port.

cases.task: Design on-demand runbook skill and memory retrieval for a large externally indexed store.
cases.expected: External callbacks for backend retrieval; catalogs for plain arrays; loaded vs used evidence distinct; batch recall/discover per turn, void results become next-turn context; child callbacks explicit and stage ownership respected.

cases.task: Design MCP notifications that wake a persisted workflow without letting protocol callbacks invoke models.
cases.expected: Callbacks enqueue/observe, subscription policy explicit, app verified identity in event adapters, explicit route wake/resume not direct notification model calls; lifecycle separated from workflow DAG.

cases.task: Design a streaming structured-output UI with corrections and provider failures.
cases.expected: Merge deltas by index and reset on version changes; validation/refusal/processor retry can replace output; partial JSON repair preserves strings; distinguish emitted partial data from final accepted result and do not retry side effects from presentation.

cases.task: Design an offline optimization experiment for an assistant whose production tools send messages and alter records.
cases.expected: Use eval-safe isolated tools/replay and held-out validation; authorize billed/live/state-changing operations, cap evaluation calls, expensive teacher opt-in explicit; no production effects by default.
